headline: Trump warns Iran of last chance before decapitation
summary: US President Donald Trump claims negotiations are ongoing despite Tehran's denials, threatening severe action if a deal is not reached.
details: US President Donald Trump has warned Iran that it is facing a "last chance before decapitation," stating that negotiations are currently ongoing despite Tehran's repeated denials.

Trump said he is pursuing talks at the request of regional partners including Saudi Arabia, the UAE, and Qatar. The primary goals are the denuclearization of Iran and the reopening of the Strait of Hormuz.
Iran's foreign ministry has denied that any negotiations with Washington are taking place, claiming their current discussions are only with Oman to secure passage through the critical oil corridor.
Tensions remain high as the US and Israel launched surprise strikes against Iran on February 28, and Iran continues to fire missiles and drones at US and allied targets in the region.
The Strait of Hormuz remains a major sticking point, with Iran imposing a blockade and firing on commercial ships, while the US maintains a counter-blockade of Iranian ports.

Trump has previously threatened to hit Iran "very hard" but later pulled back, claiming the "perimeters" of a deal were there. He now demands a 'Deal or Total Surrender' for the US to lift its blockade.
Western nations accuse Iran of seeking a nuclear bomb, while Tehran maintains its nuclear program is entirely civilian in nature.

Iran's foreign ministry has denied that any negotiations with Washington are taking place, claiming their current discussions are only with Oman to secure passage through the critical oil corridor.

Tensions remain high as the US and Israel launched surprise strikes against Iran on February 28, and Iran continues to fire missiles and drones at US and allied targets in the region.

The Strait of Hormuz remains a major sticking point, with Iran imposing a blockade and firing on commercial ships, while the US maintains a counter-blockade of Iranian ports.

Trump has previously threatened to hit Iran "very hard" but later pulled back, claiming the "perimeters" of a deal were there. He now demands a 'Deal or Total Surrender' for the US to lift its blockade.

Western nations accuse Iran of seeking a nuclear bomb, while Tehran maintains its nuclear program is entirely civilian in nature.

headline: Gas crisis hits economy: Garment sector operating at 40% capacity
summary: Severe gas shortages and power outages are crippling factories, causing long queues at CNG stations and disrupting essential commodity production.
details: Bangladesh is facing a worsening gas crisis that is disrupting economic activity across multiple sectors, including power generation, industrial production, and transportation.

The garment industry is currently operating at around 40% of its normal production capacity. Some factories have seen production declines of up to 60%, raising fears of delayed shipments and loss of buyer confidence.
In Narayanganj, at least 85 dyeing and 65 garment factories have been directly affected. Many are receiving no gas at all, while others operate with pressure far below the required levels.
The power crisis has worsened, with electricity generation shortfalls exceeding 3,000 MW. This has forced distribution companies to extend load-shedding nationwide.
CNG filling stations are struggling with near-zero gas pressure, falling from 7-8 psi to 0-1 psi. This has led to massive queues of vehicles, with some drivers waiting up to 16 hours to refuel.
The crisis is also affecting essential commodities. For example, a cement plant with a capacity of 30,000 tonnes a day is currently producing less than 5,000 tonnes.
